g.aria-label: Hosted Notebook Runtimes: What Vanishes vs. What Survives
Destroyed after idle timeout or 12h limit
Never trust local VM disk overnight!
1. Idempotent setup cell in the notebook
Core Rule: Treat every hosted VM as replaceable cattle, never as a pet machine.
If your first cell rebuilds packages and your loop
checkpoints to durable storage, resets cost nothing.
